chapter: Memphis, Oklahoma, the Kirk band and Kansas City
title: The Pearl Theatre in Philadelphia and the double piano
summary: Billed as Blanche Calloway at the Pearl Theatre, Andy put her on a small piano beside Jack on a Steinway. When Jack fell ill she took the big piano and was kept.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Pearl Theatre, we were working at the Pearl Theatre

in Philadelphia. Andy decided to use me for that theatre date, so he put me on a little miniature piano and had Jack on a big Steinway. So I was on the left of it, a left-handed stage, and he was over to the right. One afternoon Jack got sick or something happened to him. Steeple used to bring people in - he said, "Call the kid." He had the people sitting in the theatre just listening to me play and all that but they wouldn't do anything about Jack. So this particular time when Jack got sick, or whatever happened to him, I jumped on the big piano and started playing. That ended his career. Steeple said, "You don't need him. Keep her - great!"
